notes: Best-documented conference in the union. Two public calendars: (1) scc.adventist.org/events (The Events Calendar; REST API returned 110 occurrences Oct 2025 - Feb 2027, including many local-church events the conference promotes - concerts, health fairs, evangelistic series); (2) the Outlook "MASTER CALENDAR" linked from the home page (129 entries, Jul 2026 - Mar 2027) showing the internal rhythm: region pastors' meetings, ADCOM, committees, Hispanic Region evangelism weeks, preaching conference, treasurer training.
The master calendar only starts in Jul 2026, so internal/pastoral meetings for Oct 2025 - Jun 2026 are not visible; administrative and pastoral counts are therefore weighted to the upcoming period.

Recurring master-calendar series counted from RRULEs within the window (e.g., executive officers weekly x39); individual cancellations ("Canceled: ...") were not subtracted from series counts and canceled one-offs were dropped.

Excluded: office closures/holidays, staff weekly worship, office picnic, region Christmas party, evangelism-endowment deadline; master-calendar duplicates of public events (Impact26, Pathfinder Camporee, Kids & Family Fun day) kept once.
HYM Camp date conflict: public calendar Sep 4-7, 2026; master calendar "Hisp Reg HYM Camp" Aug 28 - Sep 1. Public date kept with a note.

Master-calendar events link to the Outlook HTML viewer published on the SCC home page; that viewer refuses non-browser clients (HTTP 417), while the ICS feed in calendarUrls downloads normally and is the machine-readable source.

Regions: GLAR (Greater Los Angeles Region), LAMR (Los Angeles Metropolitan Region), West Region, Asian/Pacific Region, Hispanic Region - each with its own pastors' meetings and committees. Names of individuals were removed from titles (e.g., a concert artist).
